programs.description: Living in Mumbai, Rahul and Karan dream of living luxurious lives despite their meagre salaries. When they get evicted from their apartment for not paying the rent, they hunt for rich girlfriends.
Mimi, a small-time dancer from Rajasthan, decides to lend her womb to a wealthy American couple to fund her lifelong dream of becoming a Bollywood actress.
Bringing the best in television.
A whacky situation arises when a bunch of first-time hijackers try to take over a plane but accidentally get high along with the passengers.
After being molested, Minal, along with her friends, tries to file an FIR against a politician's nephew. When the subsequent case gets rigged, Deepak, a retired lawyer, helps them to fight the case.
A Sikh family tries to survive the tumultuous aftermath of the prime minister's assassination, an incident that sparked religious violence across the country.
Jayesh believes in equal rights for women despite living with a deeply patriarchal family. When he learns his second child will be female, he makes a plan to protect his wife from his family.
During the Emergency, Indu's husband, a government employee, plans to use the situation to his advantage and move ahead in his career. However, Indu's sense of morality sets her on a different path.
Raj and Mita yearn to get Pia, their daughter, educated from a reputed school. When they learn that their background is holding her back, they do everything to ensure that she gets into the school.
Preity and Vishal, two incompatible collegians, impersonating their friends on social media, find love as they work together.
Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. However, the two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back.

A cricket-obsessed Punjabi girl from a small village, Veera faces rejection from the men's team trials. Undeterred, she transforms into Veer, a boy, securing a spot on the team and her chance to play.
Satya, a determined sister, reaches the foreign land where her brother is wrongfully imprisoned. She risks everything in a daring mission to break him free and save his life.

Nikhil, a chef, falls for Ambar, a medical student, proposes to her, and eventually they move in together. However, their shared future faces an unforeseen challenge when Ambar discovers she is pregnant.
A couple discovers themselves unconscious in a flat that is believed to be haunted by a woman who meddles with paranormal forces.
After her father sells her sister to a local landlord, Sonia sets out on a mission to rescue her sister from international sex traffickers.
A woman has a chance encounter with the friend of her late father, who coincidentally ran the Bioscope show she loved as a kid.
Six young contestants undergo bizarre tests and stop at nothing to top the list of the young faces responsible for shaping 'The New India' and eventually meet George Bush.
Meenakshi is a drama queen who falls in love with Surya, a Tamil actor. Although she is engaged to another person, she still dreams of getting married to Surya.
One fateful Thursday, the city of Mumbai experiences tremendous horror when Naina, a nursery school teacher, holds 16 children hostage and produces a list of unfathomable demands.
Ganga Ram Chaudhary, a corrupt and uneducated politician, goes to jail due to the efforts of the police. However, he soon discovers the value of education and decides to earn his 10th-grade diploma.
Nakul, a 25-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend in jeopardy.
Pinky, an aspiring dancer, gets into an accident with Nandan and loses her eyesight. A guilt-ridden Nandan decides to help her gain her confidence and helps her prepare for a reality show.
Aditya is trying to recover from his wife's betrayal and his physical disability. Meanwhile, Indrajeet Singh, a prince whose property was confiscated by Aditya's family, returns to exact revenge.

Two brothers reunite when their grandfather suddenly falls ill. However, their reunion re-ignites past drama when they both fall for the same girl.
An Indian proprietor strives to sustain his enterprise against fierce global rivalry. Furthermore, he endeavours to compensate his family for lost time.
Hari, a curious pre-teen from Mumbai with a Hindu mother and Muslim father, vows to restore his father's shaken faith after a series of challenging events.
During the emergency era of 1975, Rani Gitanjali's palace in Jaipur is raided for gold. When the government decides to transfer the gold via road to Delhi, she asks her bodyguard to seize it back.
Gippi, an overweight teenager, struggles to handle the physical and social changes that come with her age. Soon, she learns to let go of her insecurities and love herself for exactly who she is.
Despite facing a loss in the 1952 Summer Olympics, Coach Rahim builds a formidable football team and strives to bring glory to India.
Aisha, who enjoys playing Cupid despite her friend Arjun's disapproval, finds a new target, Shefali. However, her meddling ultimately damages her own relationships with close friends.
Raj, a veterinarian from Mumbai, returns to his father's elephant reserve. There, he learns of a poaching operation being conducted and sets out to thwart them.
Veer and Geet fall in love and decide to marry but Veer messes up his first impression on Geet's father, causing further obstacles.
A street-smart policeman tries to catch a gang of social vigilantes who adopt unconventional means to unmask corrupt people. Soon, he himself becomes a member of the gang.
Sardar sets out to avenge his father who was murdered by Ramadhir Singh, a cunning politician and mining kingpin. In the ensuing war, many unresolved family feuds erupt creating unrest.

Karan, a young middle-class graduate, is devastated when his mother sells her jewellery to fund his father's hospitalisation. Vowing to remedy the situation, he devises a plan to become rich quickly.
After his son's death, Balraj attempts to convince his daughter-in-law Malvika to marry Rajat, her childhood friend. However, his endeavours are disregarded by his wife and elder brother.
Two friends set up a website where couples can elope and get married against the wishes of their families. Their project is an instant hit as it helps different people get married.
The desperate need for money drives Jerry into the world of drug peddling. However, when she tries to quit her dangerous job, her situation worsens.
Major Jai Bakshi relinquishes his position to take up arms against the higher-ups after catching wind of a large-scale corruption scheme brewing within the military.
Montu is a lazy physical training instructor who does the bare minimum to stay employed. However, a new teacher threatens to take his job and the woman he loves.
A sighted pianist, feigning blindness, faces myriad complications after inadvertently witnessing an ex-film star's murder.
Nandan, a middle-class man, is chased by a gangster, a corrupt politician and a cop when he finds a suitcase full of money.
Hell breaks loose when Ra.One, the powerful antagonist of a video game, takes a physical form and attempts to destroy Shekhar's, the video game designer's, family.
Having broken two hearts in the past, Raj experiences a taste of his own medicine when his lady-love rejects his marriage proposal. Consequently, he decides to repent for his actions.

Madhumita and Vishwanathan fall in love with each other but his father disapproves of the relationship as he wants his twin sons to marry two identical twins.
Lucky is molested by a Russian boy on her way to school, but she escapes and hides in Aditya's car. When a terrorist attack breaks out, the two manage to escape and hide in an isolated graveyard.
A father steals a Ferrari to fulfil his son's dream of playing at Lord's Cricket Ground. Later, he finds out that the car he stole belongs to Sachin Tendulkar.
In pre-independence India, six individuals from different families experience the throes of love, betrayal, revenge and depression.
Bollywood actor Sanjay Sanju Dutt slogs through the quagmire of personal turmoil, substance abuse, and legal battles to find his way to dizzying heights of success.
Rani is devastated after her fiancé leaves her just before the wedding. Undeterred, she decides to go on their honeymoon alone where she gets pulled out of her comfort zone and rediscovers herself.
A staunch devotee of Lord Shiva experiences a spiritual awakening after he tries to defend his son's actions that are considered vulgar by society and the court of law.
Rohan, a visually impaired man, marries Supriya, the love of his life. Their happiness is tarnished when Supriya commits suicide after being raped by influential bandits.
Aman, a Pakistani man, falls for Asha, an Indian woman, and wishes to marry her. So, he attempts to impress her family, but chaos erupts when his nationality is revealed.

Dev and Maya, who face struggles in their respective marriages, become friends. They try to help each other salvage their relationships but end up falling in love instead.
A couple discovers themselves unconscious in a flat that is believed to be haunted by a woman who meddles with paranormal forces.
After a heated argument, a son tells his middle-aged parents to separate. But when his girlfriend reveals her love for traditional family values, conflict and tension arise between the couple.
Prithviraj Chauhan paints a target on his back when he agrees to offer Mir Hossain protection from his brother, Muhammad Ghori.
Brothers Puran and Kala get their hands on an ancient Ayurvedic remedy that cures all illnesses. However, chaos ensues after Kala falls in love with a surgeon named Chiku.
Led by an ambitious captain, India charges into the 1983 Cricket World Cup final as the underdog to claim a historic victory against defending champion West Indies.
Ashfaq, a self-centred and arrogant Bollywood star, must confront his own values when a murder accusation forces him to choose between maintaining his celebrity status and clearing his conscience.
A family wedding becomes a turning point for two couples from different generations to confront their misunderstandings, hidden affairs, and doubts that test their love and relationships.
Ranvir Singh, a businessman, embarks on a mission to avenge the death of his wife, who was killed in a car blast caused by a powerful gangster.
Ashok and Kumar are best friends who live with Maamaji. Chaos ensues when Maamaji comes up with a series of plans to take Ashok's wealth that accidentally expose them to two sets of lookalikes.

Yash and Raj, childhood friends and petty thieves, rob a bank, causing the innocent manager to be blamed. To prove his innocence, the manager devises a plan to apprehend the culprits.
Despite facing a loss in the 1952 Summer Olympics, Coach Rahim builds a formidable football team and strives to bring glory to India.
A musician must compose 100 songs in order to reunite with his lover. However, his journey of heartbreak, redemption, loss and faith allows him to discover much more than love.
After their Sunday game is cancelled, five friends look for their own place to play football in the crowded city of Mumbai.
Three friends form a fake extortion gang to quell their financial problems. However, the secretive company gains fame overnight and finds itself getting entrusted by numerous callers.
Lord Mountbatten, the last Viceroy of India, is tasked with overseeing the transition to Independence; however, he faces numerous challenges as the country undergoes a monumental change: Partition.
Inspector Mauli, a cowardly policeman, shares his name with his twin brother who has a starkly different personality. When the two move to a lawless village, things take a chaotic and dangerous turn.
Karan and Rhea meet on a flight and end up hating each other at the end of their journey. Things change between them when they continue to bump into each other at different stages of their lives.
After a series of career and relationship downturns, Kaira begins suffering from insomnia. She contacts Dr Jehangir Khan, a psychologist, who uses unconventional methods to treat her.

programs.showName: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai Dobaara
programs.description: Shoaib becomes the new mafia leader after killing his mentor, Sultan Mirza. He later finds a protégé in Aslam, but trouble ensues when they both fall in love with the same woman, Jasmine.
